name: hcapp_processPayment
description: Records, confirms, or cancels a single payment for an event attendance (or membership/haberdashery when productType != 1). Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 40) with a COMPOUND token context — @param = UPPER(DeviceSecret) + UPPER(hasherEventMapId or GUID_EMPTY) + '#' + INT(paymentAmount or 0), built from the parameters before validation (lines 171-180), so the token binds the call to one HEM and one whole-unit amount. paymentType codes: 1=not paid (cancel existing), 2=free, 3=cash, 4=bank transfer, 5=cash (other amount), 6=hash credit, 7=bank transfer (other amount), 8=credit (other amount), 100=confirm bank transfer (WankerBanker confirmation only). Creates HasherEventMap if none exists. Cancels any prior active payment before inserting a new one. On success, delegates to hcapp_syncEventAdminData or hcapp_syncUserData based on @appDomainType. Permission gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission @functionKey = 'takePayment' in the paying event's kennel (errorCode 1340, errorType 13) is required for every money path, with two exemptions — a hare of the event being paid for, and SELF-SERVICE (1.6.0): a hasher settling their OWN run fee (payer = caller, productType 1, paymentType 4 or 6, no @specialRunPrice). Self-service covers the run-start check-in prompt and the run detail payment icons; cash (3/5), other-amount (7/8), mark-not-paid (1) and confirm-transfer (100) remain admin-only. Idempotent replays (@clientPaymentId) are acknowledged with alreadyProcessed = 1 and no writes. Rowsets 2+ are the delegated sync SP's.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to ValidateAppAuth. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Compound access token. ValidateAppAuth is called with @param = DeviceSecret + HemId + '#' + INT(paymentAmount). Flutter generates with paramString: deviceSecret + hasherEventMapId + '#' + paymentAmount.toInt(). GUID_EMPTY is used as a placeholder when hasherEventMapId is unknown. The HC5 compound token also included userId and eventId; those components were dropped in HC6. No SQL default.

parameters.name: userIdWhoPaid
parameters.description: The hasher being paid for. Resolved from the HasherEventMap row if @hasherEventMapId is provided and this is NULL. Zero-UUID is normalised to NULL before token construction.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The event being paid for (or the anchor run for a membership). Required when productType is 1 or 2 — errorCode 1240, errorType 12 when NULL; may be NULL for productType 3 only when @hasherEventMapId is supplied (the event is then read from the HEM). Zero-UUID is normalised to NULL before token construction. NO SQL DEFAULT: a client that omits the parameter (rather than sending NULL) gets an unlogged 500 and never reaches the 1240 check.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapId
parameters.description: The specific HasherEventMap row. Resolved from userIdWhoPaid + eventId if NULL. If neither resolves an existing row, a new HEM is inserted. Zero-UUID is normalised to NULL before token construction.

parameters.name: paymentType
parameters.description: 1=not paid (cancel), 2=free, 3=cash, 4=bank transfer, 5=cash (other amount), 6=hash credit, 7=bank transfer (other amount), 8=credit (other amount), 100=confirm bank transfer. No SQL default.

parameters.name: productType
parameters.description: 1=event, 2=membership, 3=haberdashery. productType=2 records a credit-neutral membership payment (debit = fee) and advances HKM.MembershipExpirationDate per Kennel.MembershipRenewalMode (1=rolling +MembershipDurationInMonths from max(expiry, now); 2=fixed year (RECURRING annual window: only the month/day of Kennel.MembershipPeriodEndDate matter, its year is a sentinel; expiry = day after the NEXT occurrence of that month/day; refused errorType 2 only if the end month/day is unconfigured); 3=lifetime, expiry = sentinel 2999-12-31, refused if already lifetime). eventId is required (anchor). The HEM is anchor-only: no attendance/RSVP is set. The exists/cancel-existing logic is ProductType-scoped: each product keeps its own single-active-payment-per-HEM invariant. productType=3 (haberdashery, 1.2.0): debit = sale amount (@specialRunPrice override, else @paymentAmount); no event pricing/discounts/extras; HEM is anchor-only; MULTIPLE sales per HEM co-exist (no cancel-existing); paymentType=1 is refused (errorType 2) — individual sale cancellation is future work.

parameters.name: paymentAmount
parameters.description: Amount paid or owed. Required when paymentType < 100 (a param-validation error is returned if NULL or < 0). Cast to INT for token derivation — payments with fractional cents lose precision in the token.
parameters.typeMismatch: DECIMAL(12,6) in SP; Payment.CreditAmount and DebitAmount are SMALLMONEY (4 decimals) in the table and the intermediate variables are MONEY — project standard is DECIMAL(10,4) for monetary values.

parameters.name: minimumAttendenceValue
parameters.description: Minimum attendance state to set on the HEM row when paying. Negative values (sentinel -1) are normalised to NULL before use, which causes the AttendenceState CASE expression to compare against NULL and never raise the state — effectively a no-op minimum.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor forwarded to the delegated sync SP. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor forwarded to the delegated sync SP. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: paymentsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor forwarded to the delegated sync SP. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: kennelCreditsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor forwarded to the delegated sync SP. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: doPayForExtras
parameters.description: 0 = run fee only, 1 = include EventPriceForExtras in the debit. Defaults to 0 if NULL.

parameters.name: surcharge
parameters.description: Optional surcharge. Stored as COALESCE(surcharge, 0). Payment.Surcharge column is SMALLMONEY — implicit narrowing conversion on insert.
parameters.typeMismatch: DECIMAL(10,4) in SP parameter; Payment.Surcharge is SMALLMONEY in the table.

parameters.name: paymentProvider
parameters.description: External payment provider name (e.g. 'Stripe'). Since 1.7.0 (2026-09-26, E8.F7.S1): with paymentType 1 and a clientPaymentId on a run fee (productType 1), a non-empty provider makes the SP insert a card hand-off MARKER row (PaymentType 1, credit 0, debit 0, provider lowercased, id = clientPaymentId) after cancelling the active run payment. The outcome is recorded by a later ordinary type 3 (paid) or type 1 without provider (not paid).

parameters.name: appDomainType
parameters.description: Controls which sync SP is called after the write. 'AppDomainType.event' (default) → HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData; any other value → HC6.hcapp_syncUserData.

parameters.name: paymentReference
parameters.description: Payment reference string. Auto-generated as 'HC:' + base-36 random if NULL. Uniqueness is enforced via a retry loop before insert.

parameters.name: transactionTimestamp
parameters.description: Client-supplied payment timestamp as a string. Line 865: COALESCE(TRY_CAST(LEFT(@transactionTimestamp, 23) AS DATETIME), GETDATE()) — truncated to 23 chars, parsed WITHOUT an offset, and a malformed string silently becomes GETDATE() rather than an error. Not used on the card-marker or combined-run-leg inserts (those stamp GETDATE()).
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) in SP; Payment.PaidDate is DATETIMEOFFSET(7). The intermediate DATETIME has no offset, so the implicit widening stores a client-local time as if it were +00:00.

parameters.name: specialRunPrice
parameters.description: Override price for this payment. Used as the debit amount instead of the calculated event price when set. If @useSpecialPriceAsDefault is non-zero, the derived discount is also persisted to HasherKennelMap. For productType=2 this overrides Kennel.MembershipPrice as the membership fee.

parameters.name: specialRunPriceReason
parameters.description: Free-text reason for the special price. Stored as COALESCE(specialRunPriceReason, ''). Also written to HasherKennelMap.DiscountDescription when @useSpecialPriceAsDefault is non-zero.

parameters.name: useSpecialPriceAsDefault
parameters.description: When non-zero and @specialRunPrice is set, the derived discount (originalEventPrice - specialRunPrice) is saved as a permanent discount on HasherKennelMap for this hasher at this kennel. Sentinel: NULL is treated as 0 (do not persist).

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Free-text note stored on the payment (haberdashery item description). Blank/whitespace stored as NULL. Added 1.2.0.

parameters.name: alsoPayRunFee
parameters.description: productType 2 only: 1 = also record the run fee at MEMBER pricing (zero price => FREE with 'member' Notes tag, other-amount methods map to base types, extras never included) and check the payer in (attendance floor minimumAttendenceValue, default 20) — atomically with the membership charge. Ignored (forced 0) for other product types. Added 1.4.0.

parameters.name: clientPaymentId
parameters.description: Idempotency key (1.5.0): the client generates the Payment row's id and retries the same request with the same id until acknowledged. If a Payment with this id already exists (any state, cancelled included) the call is a replay: success is returned with adHocData.alreadyProcessed = 1 and nothing is written. NULL (old clients) preserves server-side NEWID().

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Write SP success envelope. Always rowset 0. On auth failure (ValidateAppAuth codes), validation (1240 / type 12), permission (1340 / type 13), membership refusals (1245, 1246 / type 2), haberdashery cancel refusal (1247 / type 2) or CATCH (1940 / type 19) it is followed by ErrorDetail at index 1 and the SP returns; on success by PaymentResult then the sync rowsets.

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 on any failure.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. 1240 validation; 1340 not authorised; 1245 membership year not set; 1246 already a lifetime member; 1247 haberdashery cannot be cancelled; 1940 unhandled (CATCH); ValidateAppAuth codes on auth failure.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 12 validation; 13 not authorised; 2 membership/haberdashery refusals; 19 CATCH; ValidateAppAuth's type on auth failure.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Present only on failure (after the Envelope rowset with success=0). Contains the HC.ErrorLog entry id and human-readable messages.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: ID of the inserted HC.ErrorLog row.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Same value as in the Envelope rowset.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Same value as in the Envelope rowset.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Short display title for the error.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing error message.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: SP name via OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: PaymentResult
rowsets.description: Present only on success (after the Envelope rowset with success=1). Single row summarising the processed payment. Two short-circuit paths return a sparse row: paymentType=100 (confirm bank transfer, lines 338-356) and the idempotent replay (lines 462-480, alreadyProcessed=1) — on both, hasherWhoPaid, attendenceState, rsvpState, debitAmount, creditAmount, creditAvailable, newMembershipExpiry, runFeeAmount and runFeePaymentType are NULL and the discount columns are 0 / ''. The full row (1070-1095) is emitted after the post-commit credit and run-count refresh.

columns.name: adHocDataId
columns.description: Always 1. Identifies this as an ad-hoc result row to the client.

columns.name: hasherWhoPaid
columns.description: Display name of the payer, formatted per NameDisplayPreference. Falls back to HEM.DisplayName, then '<no name>'. NULL for paymentType=100 path.

columns.name: attendenceState
columns.description: Attendance state after payment (after applying minimumAttendenceValue if higher). NULL for paymentType=100 path.

columns.name: rsvpState
columns.description: Always 3 after any successful payment.

columns.name: paymentType
columns.description: The @paymentType value used.

columns.name: productType
columns.description: The @productType value used.

columns.name: debitAmount
columns.description: Amount owed after discounts (and special price if applied). NULL for paymentType=100 path.

columns.name: creditAmount
columns.description: Amount credited (0 for hash credit types 6 and 8). NULL for paymentType=100 path.

columns.name: paymentAmount
columns.description: The raw @paymentAmount parameter value as supplied by the caller.

columns.name: creditAvailable
columns.description: Kennel credit balance for the payer after the credit update. NULL for paymentType=100 path.

columns.name: paymentReference
columns.description: Generated or supplied payment reference code.

columns.name: discountAmount
columns.description: Discount amount applied (from HasherKennelMap or special price override). 0 for paymentType=100.

columns.name: discountPercent
columns.description: Discount percentage applied (from HasherKennelMap). 0 for paymentType=100.

columns.name: discountDescription
columns.description: Discount reason text (from HasherKennelMap or special price reason). Empty string for paymentType=100.

columns.name: newMembershipExpiry
columns.description: productType=2 only: the MembershipExpirationDate just written (2999-12-31 = lifetime). NULL for all other products and for paymentType=100. Additive in 1.1.0.

columns.name: runFeeAmount
columns.description: Combined membership+run only (alsoPayRunFee=1): the amount the run leg charged (0 when recorded as free). NULL otherwise. Additive, 1.4.0.

columns.name: runFeePaymentType
columns.description: Combined membership+run only: how the run leg was recorded (2=free member run, else the base method type). NULL otherwise. Additive, 1.4.0.

columns.name: alreadyProcessed
columns.description: 1 when this call was an idempotent replay of an already-recorded payment (nothing was written); 0 otherwise. Additive in 1.5.0.

rowsets.name: SyncRowsets
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ are the output of the delegated sync SP (HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData or HC6.hcapp_syncUserData), passed through verbatim. See the contract for the relevant sync SP for column definitions.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — when @hasherEventMapId is NULL and no row exists for (@userIdWhoPaid, @eventId), under an UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK range lock (382-405); neutral (RsvpState 0, no attendance) for productType 2/3 without @alsoPayRunFee, otherwise RsvpState 3 + AttendenceState = @minimumAttendenceValue or 0.
SELECT ... WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) on the HEM row (441-444) — serialises every payment operation for that HEM to COMMIT; the replay check sits behind it.
paymentType 100: UPDATE HC.Payment SET ConfirmedDate, ConfirmedBy_UserId, updatedAt WHERE HasherEventMapId = @hasherEventMapId AND CancelledDate IS NULL (328-332), then COMMIT and GOTO the sync.

paymentType 1: UPDATE HC.Payment SET IsCancelled=1, CancelledDate, CancelledBy_UserId for the live same-product payment on the HEM (633-639); for productType 2 first restores HasherKennelMap.MembershipExpirationDate from Payment.PreviousMembershipExpiry (624-631).

paymentType 1 + @paymentProvider + @clientPaymentId on productType 1: INSERT HC.Payment card hand-off MARKER (id = @clientPaymentId, type 1, credit 0, debit 0, provider lowercased, own 'HC:' reference) (676-698).
paymentType 2-8: UPDATE HC.Event SET DoTrackHashCash=1 if not set (728-729).
paymentType 6 or productType 2: INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap (Following=1, IsKennelFollowing=1, IsMember=0) for a payer with no live row at the kennel (735-753).
paymentType 5/7/8 with @specialRunPrice and @useSpecialPriceAsDefault <> 0: UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap SET DiscountAmount, DiscountPercent=0, DiscountDescription (779-784).

paymentType 2-8, productType 1 or 2: UPDATE HC.Payment cancels the live same-product payment on the HEM (837-843); for productType 2 the pre-payment expiry is restored first (825-835). productType 3 never cancels.
paymentType 2-8: INSERT HC.Payment (id = @clientPaymentId or NEWID(); PaidDate from @transactionTimestamp or GETDATE(); PreviousMembershipExpiry stamped for productType 2) (851-873).
productType 2: UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap SET MembershipExpirationDate per MembershipRenewalMode (916-920).
productType 1: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET UserStartEvent, RsvpState=3, AttendenceState raised to @minimumAttendenceValue (927-932).

productType 2 + @alsoPayRunFee: second cancel of the live run payment (988-995), second INSERT HC.Payment for the run leg (NEWID(), member pricing) (1006-1024), and check-in of the HEM with floor COALESCE(@minimumAttendenceValue, 20) (1027-1033).

Post-commit, outside TRY/CATCH: EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateKennelCreditByUser (1061); EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser for @userIdWhoPaid when set (1065-1066). Skipped on the type-100 and replay paths (GOTO).

EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData (appDomainType 'AppDomainType.event') or HC6.hcapp_syncUserData (anything else), @procName = this SP, @param = the compound suffix, so the delegated SP re-validates the same token (1103-1130).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on every refusal and in CATCH; every in-transaction log is written AFTER ROLLBACK so it survives (2026-09-06 fix).

codeSmells.issue: @paymentAmount cast to INT in token derivation — truncates fractional units
codeSmells.detail: Lines 177-180: the compound suffix uses CAST(CAST(COALESCE(@paymentAmount, 0) AS INT) AS NVARCHAR(50)). A payment of 5.75 signs against 5; the client must build the token with the same truncation (paymentAmount.toInt()) or every fractional payment fails auth. Inherited from HC5; both sides agree today, so this is a trap for the next client, not a live fault.

codeSmells.issue: paymentType 100 with a NULL HEM confirms nothing and reports success
codeSmells.detail: Lines 326-359: the confirm-transfer branch updates WHERE HasherEventMapId = @hasherEventMapId. @hasherEventMapId is optional and is never resolved from @userIdWhoPaid on this branch (that lookup is at 364-406, after the GOTO), so a confirm sent without the HEM id matches zero rows and still returns success=1 — the WankerBanker sees 'confirmed', the row stays unconfirmed. Resolve the HEM first, or refuse NULL on this branch.

These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken, @paymentType. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: @transactionTimestamp parsed without an offset and malformed values silently dropped
codeSmells.detail: Line 865: TRY_CAST(LEFT(@transactionTimestamp, 23) AS DATETIME) drops any timezone suffix and returns NULL (=> GETDATE()) for anything it cannot parse, so a client-local timestamp is stored in Payment.PaidDate DATETIMEOFFSET(7) as if it were UTC, and an unparseable one is replaced by the server clock with no signal. Parse as DATETIMEOFFSET from the full string and refuse what does not parse.

Lines 1061-1095 (credit refresh, run-count refresh, envelope, adHocData) and the delegated sync at 1103-1130 run after END CATCH. A failure there is a raw 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row AFTER the payment has committed. The phone-side outbox retries and hits the replay path (alreadyProcessed = 1), so money is not duplicated — but the credit/run-count refresh for that payment never runs until the next payment for the same hasher.

codeSmells.issue: Monetary intermediates are MONEY / SMALLMONEY, not DECIMAL(10,4)
codeSmells.detail: Lines 239-243, 411-413, 948-950: @eventPrice, @creditAmount, @debitAmount, @originalEventPrice, @extrasPrice, @runPrice are MONEY; @creditAvailable, @discountAmount SMALLMONEY; @specialRunPrice SMALLMONEY; @surcharge DECIMAL(10,4) into Payment.Surcharge SMALLMONEY; Event/Kennel prices are DECIMAL(10,4). Project standard is DECIMAL(10,4) throughout. The percentage step at 527 ('@eventPrice * (@discountPercent / 100.0)') rounds on MONEY, differently from processBulkPayment's single-expression formula, so the same hasher can be charged a cent apart by the two SPs.

codeSmells.issue: minimumAttendenceValue: negative means NULL, and NULL means 'never raise'
codeSmells.detail: Line 161 maps any negative value to NULL; the UPDATE at 930 then compares AttendenceState < NULL (UNKNOWN) and never raises the state, while a NEW HEM (404) gets COALESCE(NULL, 0) = 0 and the combined-run leg (1030-1032) floors at 20. Three different outcomes for the same 'no minimum' input; the -1 sentinel is undocumented outside this contract.

The 'HC:' + NUMBER_TO_STR_BASE reference loop appears three times (666-674, 756-764, 996-1004) and the cancel-live-payment UPDATE three times (633-639, 837-843, 988-995). One helper would keep them identical.

codeSmells.issue: paymentType=100 and replay paths skip the credit refresh
codeSmells.detail: GOTO SyncAndReturn (358, 482) jumps over nonApi_updateKennelCreditByUser, so creditAvailable is NULL on those rows — intentional (nothing changed the balance) but a caller must not treat NULL as zero.

Lifetime membership (MembershipRenewalMode=3) is MembershipExpirationDate = 2999-12-31 (line 426) rather than a flag, so every 'expiry > GETDATE()' consumer works unchanged. Deliberate, documented (docs/membership_payments_plan.md).

breakingChanges: TRY/CATCH and BEGIN TRANSACTION added — HC5 had no error handling or transaction. Error paths now roll back all writes atomically.

Success envelope rowset added as rowset 0 — HC5 returned PaymentResult directly as the first rowset. Callers must now read rowset 0 (success/errorCode/errorType) before consuming the PaymentResult at rowset 1.
ErrorDetail rowset introduced — HC5 had no structured error rowset. Failure paths now return two rowsets (Envelope + ErrorDetail).
Delegation targets updated to HC6 SPs — HC5 called HC5.hcapp_syncEventAdminData and HC5.hcapp_syncUserData; HC6 calls HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData and HC6.hcapp_syncUserData.
HC6 schema — all objects are in the HC6 schema; no HC5 schema objects are referenced.

1.8.0 (2026-10-13): contract corrections only, no SP change — @eventId marked non-nullable (no SQL default); description now states the compound token and the 1340 gate; smells re-pointed at current line numbers (the old '~' numbers were from before the 2026-08/09 additions); TRY_CAST fallback, type-100-without-HEM and post-commit-outside-TRY recorded; nonApi targets are HC6.
behaviorNotes: 1.4.0 zero-price => FREE: for productType 1, paymentType 3/4/6 with computed run price (before extras) <= 0, the payment is recorded as PaymentType 2 with Notes 'member'/'non-member' (by the payer's membership status). Other-amount types 5/7/8 are never coerced. adHocData paymentType reflects the coerced value.
